whl_ranger.text: Loch Lomond and the Trossachs became Scotland's first national park in 2002. We look after about seven hundred square miles of water, woodland and hill.
The capercaillie lek in the old pines to the south. They're very rare now, and very rude. If a big dark grouse the size of a turkey squares up to you, you've been noticed.

whl_ranger2.text: I did Ben Lomond yesterday. 974 metres, the most southerly Munro. Went up in sunshine, came down in four kinds of weather. Scotland does that.
